limitations: Fifteen epochs are an engineering cohort, not a 100-epoch capacity experiment.
Only two seeds estimate optimization variance.
The cohort contains 322 train and 100 validation parent CADs, not the full ABC corpus.
No generation, OCC validity, sequence regeneration or AR training is included.
All curved parent-cluster MSE values remain orders of magnitude above 5e-5, so downstream promotion is prohibited.
